name: agent-smith
description: Offload bulky or research-heavy text + first-draft code to Google Gemini (cloud API or OAuth-subscription CLI), local Ollama, or Apple Foundation Models, then verify and finish with Claude to spare Claude's tokens. Includes a sandboxed agentic tool-loop (smith_agent.py, ollama/gemini/openai backends), LOCAL VISION (screenshot triage via --file on ollama), --batch mode (many files, one prompt, zero per-item orchestration), a usage ledger with a verified-good/bad quality loop, hebbian routing weights (task-shape x model quality + streak-based review tiers), and consensus batch mode (two models vote, disagreement auto-escalates), and a disk-aware local-model installer.
